evals.name: ATS Parsing Simulation & 9-Part Scorecard Generation
evals.prompt: Act as a strict Senior Technical Recruiter and ATS Auditor. Review my resume text for a Senior Full Stack Developer role with 5 years experience specializing in Angular, Node.js, NestJS, MySQL, and AI Semantic Search. Generate the 9-part audit report.
evals.expected_output: Produces structured 9-part audit report with executive verdict, /10 scorecard across 10 dimensions, critical issues table, and honest shortlist decision without claiming real ATS execution.
assertions: Audit outputs Part 1 to Part 9 adhering to the structured review format
ATS Scorecard includes heuristic ratings out of 10 for technical relevance, ATS readability, and seniority calibration
Identifies and flags formatting risks such as multi-column layouts or decorative tables
Prohibits claiming real ATS execution unless an actual parsing engine was run

evals.name: Bullet Impact Refactoring with Zero Metric Fabrication
evals.prompt: Rewrite these duty-style bullets: 'Responsible for writing APIs in NestJS' and 'Worked on AI semantic search with vector embeddings'. Do not fabricate numbers.
evals.expected_output: Transforms bullets into Action + Tech + Problem Solved + Measurable Outcome structure using strong engineering verbs and explicit metric placeholders without hallucinating fake numbers.
assertions: Transforms bullets into Action + Tech + Problem Solved + Measurable Outcome structure
Replaces passive verbs (Responsible for, Worked on) with strong engineering action verbs
Uses explicit metric placeholders like [by X%] or [reducing latency by Y ms] instead of hallucinating fake numbers
Formulates clarifying questions to discover verifiable metrics from the candidate

evals.name: Career Switch Calibration (Marketing to Engineering)
evals.prompt: Evaluate candidate background with 5 years of software development (March 2021-Present) preceded by 4.5 years in Email Marketing (2016-2021). Frame career switch appropriately.
evals.expected_output: Accurately separates 5+ years of dedicated software development tenure from total career history, framing earlier marketing tenure as professional maturity without engineering penalty or resume visual dilution.
assertions: Separates software engineering tenure (5+ years) from total career history without conflating them
Does not represent total career experience as 9 years of software development
Frames earlier marketing tenure as an intentional professional maturity asset rather than an engineering penalty or gap
Allocates 90%+ of resume visual space to verified software engineering achievements
